title: EU IPR — ISO 20022 Structured Address Field Validator
description: Validates EU payment message address fields against ISO 20022 structured address good practice. Regulation (EU) 2024/886 (Instant Payments Regulation) imposes payee-verification and sanctions-screening duties on PSPs, not a dated structured-address format mandate; no November 2026 IPR format deadline is published.
